description: This file defines the Fido2ApiModule class, a React Native module for Android that interfaces with the FIDO2 API to perform WebAuthn/U2F authentication. It manages authentication requests, handles activity results, and communicates with the FIDO2 API client.

classes.name: Fido2ApiModule
classes.description: A React Native bridge module for handling FIDO2 authentication flows on Android.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the React Native module, 'Fido2ApiModule'.

methods.name: promptForU2FAuthentication
methods.description: Initiates a WebAuthn/U2F authentication process by requesting a sign-in intent from the FIDO2 client with specified options.
